title: Notice regarding Special Courts on 06.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 05/11/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06/11/2026;
Notification dated 27.10.2026.

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 05/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06/11/2026;
1. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen would sit
Single and take up the notified matters.
2. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice
R.T.Vachhani would sit in Special Division Bench and take up the
notified matters.
3. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 2 and Sr. No. 5, Hon’ble Mr.
Justice Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi would sit
in Regular Division Bench and take up the matters as per Roster.
4. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai would sit Single
and take up the notified matters.
5. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi would sit Single and
take up the notified matters.
6. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray would sit Single and
take up the notified matters.
7. At 03:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray would sit Single and
take up the Specially assigned Arbitration matters as per the
Notification dated 27.10.2026.
8. After the work of Division Bench is over, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
J. L. Odedra would sit Single and take up the notified matters.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar Judicial
